body: Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-08 23:13Z, my own serious error). POST /api/sessions/ID/kill, which the UI trash also calls, removes the session AND its whole delegation-child subtree (src/delegations.rs:3887 reconcile_delegations_for_removed_session_locked). Removing Engram::Coder session-8581 on Greg's narrow word dropped /api/state sessions from 9119 to 8485, against his 'Nie usuwaj innych sesji'. My pre-check filtered /api/state delegations on parentSessionId, which that projection doesn't carry, so its zero proved nothing. Rules: before any irreversible act, read the whole code path being invoked, not its opening lines; a check that returns zero must first be shown able to return non-zero; state the blast radius to Greg BEFORE acting; and count before and after with the raw kept. A delegation's parent is not in the /api/state delegation summary. Never remove another long-lived root without Greg first hearing that its delegation children go with it.
